notes.text: PLAN-009-sizing-mechanism's TASK-081 line says the unrecorded-shape warning 'names the backfill command'. No backfill command exists in this codebase (only `sizing stats` is registered) and TASK-081's own build instructions overrode that plan line: the `sizing_unrecorded` message names the shape and states it predates the log, without inventing a command name. Do not add one on a future task without first shipping the command it would name.
